acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The Eclipse was operated in a data-dependent mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP, Sigma-Aldrich) and alkylated with 10 mM chloroacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP, Sigma-Aldrich) and alkylated with 10 mM chloroacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested overnight at 37 o C in 2 M urea/100 mM TEAB, pH 8.5, with trypsin (Promega).

fractionation_method.evidence: The digested peptides were labeled with 16-plex TMT (Thermo product A44522), and pooled samples were fractionated by a basic reversed phase (Thermo 84868).

fragmentation_method.evidence: The cycle time was set to 3 s, and within this 3 s, the most abundant ions per scan were selected for CID MS/MS in the ion trap.

instrument.evidence: The TMT-labeled samples were analyzed on an Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Peptides were eluted directly from the tip of the column and nanosprayed directly into the mass spectrometer by application of 2.5 kV voltage at the back of the column.

ptm.evidence: modifications: TMT6plex-126 reporter+balance reagent acylated residue
Carbamidomethylation on cysteine and TMT on lysine and peptide N-term were considered as static modifications.
